question: give me top 5 agents
sql:
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.email, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.email
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 5;
